title: Bellman equation의 행렬화
markdown:
## MRP에서 Value function에 대한 Bellman equation의 행렬화 ### Value function의 Bellman equation을 행렬화하여 가치함수 계산 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/4b9f9e8049b7fbab.webp) MRP에 대한 Value function의 Bellman equation에서 위 식의 관계를 만족한다. - MRP에서는 policy가 존재하지 않기 때문에 \pi 기호를 생략한다. ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/367f55094bef3646.webp) - |s| - Cardinality s - s라는 집합에 있는 원소 개수
즉, 가능한 모든 state 대한 개수를 의미한다. ### 증명 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/a75169607c5144b5.webp) - V(s') = R(s') + \gamma \Sigma_{s'} P(s' |s') V(s')
성립하는 것을 확인할 수 있다. ### Value function 계산: P, \bar{R} → V ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/3fec646ec2a76c26.webp)
ex) P=I, \gamma = 0.9 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/44b90406a149d98a.webp) - P = I 인 경우, 대각선만 1.0이 된다. ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/76e224aa7fb1077f.webp) - 동일한 state로 전이하는 재귀 구조만 가능하다. - \bar{R} (S^1) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/f8c8515db4efffc7.webp)
### 예제 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/632935fe58fccb37.webp) - P, \bar{R} 을 통해 Value function을 구할 수 있다. ## MDP에서 Value function에 대한 Bellman equation의 행렬화 > ✏️ > > > > MDP 에서 부터는 policy가 포함된다. ### MDP에서 Value function에 대한 Bellman equation의 행렬화 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/5329f97a2309b674.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/61760158eb621902.webp) - policy에 대한 value function ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/fbce2fff559aeeb3.webp) - policy에 대한 reward function ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/247d4eb9751e07d4.webp) - policy에 대한 transition probability ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/6aa9dae4bd330e82.webp) ### Value function 계산 - P^{\pi}, \bar{R}^{\pi} → V^{\pi} ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/f444d36bef0793aa.webp) - 일일이 가능한 리턴을 직접 다 따져보고 가능한 리턴의 확률이 얼마인지 계산 후 평균을 구하는 것이 아닌 - P^{\pi}(트랜지션 프로빌리티) 와 \bar{R}^{\pi}(리워드의 함수)만 알고있으면 V^{\pi}(value function)을 구할 수 있다. ### 예제 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/7bd266886a980cdf.webp) ## MDP에서 Action-Value function에 대한 Bellman equation의 행렬화 ### MDP에서 Action-Value function의 Bellman equation을 행렬화 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/3b487e218f2dc30a.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/bc316aef90101d13.webp) - policy에 대한 Action-Value function ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/e1834ab05bb97e30.webp) - policy에 대한 Reward function ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/83848c47431bfd73.webp) - policy에 대한 Transition Probability ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/17c8f6950990d4b3.webp) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/92bd1d8da4f779ae.webp) ### 증명 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/64e10b7484b32822.webp) ### Action-Value function 계산 - P^{\pi}, \bar{R} → Q^{\pi} ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/99497b73108215436bc42461f5c43d0cf09ba224/posts/345eda9b-0fe1-806c-9085-f4eff05dff16/4e20e30cef46709c.webp) - P^{\pi}(트랜지션 프로빌리티) 와 \bar{R}(리워드의 함수)를 통해 Q^{\pi}(Action-Value function)을 구할 수 있다.
